cmd: { N=/opt/tg-notify; P=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr; R=/opt/weather-pipeline/repo; cd $R; git update-ref -d refs/remotes/origin/main 2>/dev/null; git fetch -q origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main; for f in tg_post tg_htf tg_express tg_bot; do echo "$f vps=$(md5sum < $N/$f.py 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-8) repo=$(git show origin/main:bot/positions/$f.py | md5sum | cut -c1-8) mtime=$(stat -c %y $N/$f.py 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-19)"; done; echo "--- tg_post.json:"; cat $P/tg_post.json 2>&1; echo; echo "--- service:"; systemctl show tg-bot-regr -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecStart | cut -c1-200; echo "--- bak:"; ls -la --time-style=+%m-%d_%H:%M $N/bak | tail -12; echo "--- journal:"; journalctl -u tg-bot-regr --since "2026-11-17 09:00" --no-pager | grep -iE "tg_post|PST|compose|Traceback|Error|Started|Stopped" | tail -15; echo "--- other writers:"; ls -la --time-style=+%m-%d_%H:%M $N/*.py | tail -25; } 2>&1 | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
